page.overview:
Who is Marduk?

Marduk is one of the more formidable Dark Apostles of the Word Bearers Traitor Legion.

He is a former first acolyte of the Dark Apostle Jarulek, becoming a Dark Apostle and the master of the Word Bearers' 34th Host in his own right in the late 41st Millennium after his former master was slain by a newly awakened Necron Lord on the world of Tanakreg.

Marduk helped to lead the Word Bearers' massive Dark Crusade in an attempt to seize control of the strategic Boros Gate System from the Imperium of Man during the 13th Black Crusade of Abaddon the Despoiler, which the Word Bearers believed would herald the End Times and the final victory of Chaos in the galaxy.

The Battle of the Boros Gate in ca. 999.M41 proved to be a defeat for the forces of Chaos, but a personal triumph for Marduk, who uncovered and unraveled a ploy by the Dark Apostle Kor Phaeron to eliminate the loyalists of his rival Erebus for control over the Word Bearers Legion.
